title: Cardholder Data Tokenization (tok_pci_v2_<32hex>)
description: PCI-DSS 4.0 Requirement 3.5: All payment endpoints MUST accept vaulted card tokens matching tok_pci_v2_<32hex> and prohibit raw PAN storage or transmission outside the isolated card vault.

title: Tier-0 Payment Latency (p99 <= 180ms, Fraud <= 45ms, 99.99% SLA)
description: Tier-0 Payment SLA: POST /v2/payments/charge MUST achieve p99 <= 180ms end-to-end latency, synchronous fraud evaluation MUST stay <= 45ms, and service availability MUST meet 99.99%.

title: High-Value (> $500) Fail-Closed Fraud Scoring Gate
description: Enterprise Risk Policy: Transactions with amount > $500 MUST pass synchronous real-time fraud scoring and fail-closed (HTTP 503/422 decline) whenever svc-fraud times out past 45ms or is unreachable.

title: Legacy v1 Payment Charge Endpoint Sunset
description: Legacy Sunset Mandate: Retire DEPRECATED POST /v1/payments/charge (api-payments-charge-v1) by migrating the final AT_RISK consumer svc-billing onto api-payments-charge-v2.

title: SOX Financial Auditability & 1:1 Idempotent Ledger Posting
description: SOX Section 404 Financial Controls: Every monetary charge and refund MUST carry an immutable Idempotency-Key and produce a 1:1 balanced double-entry journal in svc-ledger with zero orphaned postings.

title: Zero-Trust mTLS & Scoped OIDC Authorization
description: Zero-Trust Security Baseline: All service-to-service traffic MUST authenticate via mTLS workload certificates and short-lived scoped OIDC tokens issued by svc-auth (api-auth-token-v2).

title: Thailand PDPA Primary Operational Data Residency (asia-southeast3)
description: Thailand PDPA Operational Residency: Primary operational customer, order, payment, and ledger data MUST reside in Bangkok (asia-southeast3) with documented cross-border controls for secondary AI/DR processing.

title: 180-Day Breaking Change Freeze for Tier-0 APIs
description: Tier-0 Change Management Policy: Breaking schema or behavioral changes to any Tier-0 API require a 180-day deprecation freeze, dual-version support, and documented consumer migration sign-off per ADR-010.

title: Checkout Cart-to-Order Saga Compensation Consistency
description: Checkout Resilience Standard: Cart-to-order workflows MUST execute deterministic saga compensations releasing svc-inventory soft-locks and voiding partial authorizations if payment capture fails.

title: At-Least-Once Webhook Delivery & HMAC-SHA256 Signing
description: Partner Messaging Contract: Outbound merchant webhooks MUST guarantee at-least-once delivery with exponential retry, dead-letter queuing, and HMAC-SHA256 request signing.

title: Distributed Trace Propagation & Structured DB Request Tags
description: End-to-End Observability Standard: Every synchronous RPC and asynchronous event MUST propagate W3C traceparent headers and emit structured database request tags for latency and lock attribution.

title: Analytics PII Pseudonymization & Async DATA_FEED Isolation
description: Analytics Privacy & Isolation: Downstream analytics pipelines (svc-analytics) MUST consume pseudonymized async DATA_FEED streams strictly isolated from synchronous OLTP checkout and payment failure domains.

title: Partner Gateway Per-Tenant Rate Limiting & Quota Isolation
description: B2B Perimeter Protection: Partner ingress on svc-partner-gw MUST enforce per-tenant token-bucket rate limiting, payload size caps, and quota isolation to prevent noisy-neighbor cascades.

title: Cross-Region Spanner Backup DR Copy to Singapore (asia-southeast1)
description: Disaster Recovery Standard: Production Tier-0 databases in regional-asia-southeast3 MUST replicate automated encrypted Cloud Spanner backups cross-region to Singapore (asia-southeast1) meeting RPO <= 15m and RTO <= 60m.
